fusions.name: Cut Both Ways
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A weapon strike deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Reef Closes In
fusions.desc: Reef grows up around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Caged] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tide Pool Shelter
fusions.desc: Raises a pool where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Accretion Wall
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
